from pathlib import Path
import gzip, json
from tools.baseline import main as b
from tools.baseline.data import require_exact, sha256
from tools.cuda.compare import compare
root=Path.cwd();out=root.parent/'cancellation';out.mkdir()
manifest=b.checked_manifest();binary=b.SIMULATOR/'target/release/maelstrom'
case=manifest['cases'][-1]
args=b.solver_args(binary,case,'sample','uniform-grid',cuda=(0,128))
a=b.invoke(args,timeout_s=1.5,grace_s=30)
a['arguments']=args
assert a['timed_out'] and a['exit_code']==130, a
r=a['result'];assert r['status']=='cancelled' and int(r['completed_steps'])<480
assert r['measurements']['failed_attempt_s'] is not None
steps=int(r['completed_steps'])
control=dict(case,steps=steps,checkpoints=[s for s in case['checkpoints'] if s<=steps])
args=b.solver_args(binary,control,'warmup','uniform-grid')
c=b.invoke(args);c['arguments']=args
assert c['exit_code']==0 and c['result']['status']=='completed'
for key in ['final_snapshot','checkpoints','steps']:
 require_exact(r[key],c['result'][key],key)
f=b.invoke(b.solver_args(binary,manifest['cases'][1],'warmup','uniform-grid',cuda=(0,128)))
assert f['exit_code']==0
comparison=compare(b.read_json(b.SIMULATOR/manifest['cases'][1]['golden']),f['result'],exact=True)
assert comparison['passed']
files={}
for name,value in [('timeout',a),('cpu-prefix',c),('fresh-cuda',f)]:
 payload=gzip.compress(json.dumps(value,allow_nan=False).encode(),mtime=0)
 (out/(name+'.json.gz')).write_bytes(payload);files[name]=sha256(payload)
b.write_json(out/'checks.json',{'passed':True,'timeout_s':1.5,'grace_s':30,'accepted_steps':steps,'exit_code':a['exit_code'],'failed_attempt_s':r['measurements']['failed_attempt_s'],'wall_s':a['wall_s'],'prefix_exact':True,'fresh_cuda_comparison':comparison,'files_sha256':files})
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'accepted_steps':steps,'exit_code':a['exit_code'],'wall_s':a['wall_s']}))
